# Razza Pazza

> Razza Pazza partners with entertainers, artists, creators, and brands to design, produce, and distribute jewelry from concept to customer.

The official website is https://razzapazza.com. Razza Pazza is based in New York, NY.

## About

Razza Pazza works alongside clients from the first concept through delivery to the customer, backed by a manufacturer serving leading luxury houses.

- [Company overview](https://razzapazza.com/#about): Who Razza Pazza works with and what it does.

## How We Work

Razza Pazza brings jewelry design, production, and distribution together in one partnership. Use the website's contact form to discuss a project and the support it needs.

## Services

- Jewelry design: Develop a jewelry concept with the client.
- Jewelry production: Bring the design into production with manufacturing support.
- Jewelry distribution: Support the path from finished product to customer.

Project scope, materials, pricing, quantities, and timing require confirmation for each project.

## Contact

- [Contact Razza Pazza](https://razzapazza.com/#contact): Leave your email through the website's inquiry form.
